cases.name: every family this session left in /tmp is dropped, not just the two that were listed
cases.cmd: for p in graphify-seen readbounds-seen catbounds-seen affected-seen batching-nudge batching-tick delegation clearnudge; do : > /tmp/claude-$p-{{SID}}; done; printf '{"session_id":"{{SID}}"}' | CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR={{FIX}}/cfg-{{SID}} bash .claude/hooks/session-cleanup.sh; printf 'left=%s' "$(ls /tmp/claude-*-{{SID}} 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"

cases.name: the per-agent suffix is dropped too — the bare session name never existed
cases.cmd: : > /tmp/claude-readbounds-seen-{{SID}}-agent42; : > /tmp/claude-delegation-{{SID}}-agent42; printf '{"session_id":"{{SID}}"}' | CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR={{FIX}}/cfg-{{SID}} bash .claude/hooks/session-cleanup.sh; printf 'left=%s' "$(ls /tmp/claude-*-{{SID}}-agent42 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"

cases.name: another session's fresh leftovers are left alone
cases.cmd: : > /tmp/claude-batching-nudge-other-{{SID}}; printf '{"session_id":"{{SID}}"}' | CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR={{FIX}}/cfg-{{SID}} bash .claude/hooks/session-cleanup.sh; printf 'kept=%s' "$(ls /tmp/claude-batching-nudge-other-{{SID}} 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"

cases.name: a leftover older than two days is purged whatever session wrote it
cases.cmd: : > /tmp/claude-delegation-old-{{SID}}; touch -t 202001010000 /tmp/claude-delegation-old-{{SID}}; printf '{"session_id":"{{SID}}"}' | CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR={{FIX}}/cfg-{{SID}} bash .claude/hooks/session-cleanup.sh; printf 'left=%s' "$(ls /tmp/claude-delegation-old-{{SID}} 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"

cases.name: a family nothing registers is never touched
cases.cmd: : > /tmp/claude-evalkeep-{{SID}}; touch -t 202001010000 /tmp/claude-evalkeep-{{SID}}; printf '{"session_id":"{{SID}}"}' | CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR={{FIX}}/cfg-{{SID}} bash .claude/hooks/session-cleanup.sh; printf 'kept=%s' "$(ls /tmp/claude-evalkeep-{{SID}} 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"

cases.name: a payload with no session id falls back on unknown, and cleans under that name
cases.cmd: : > /tmp/claude-clearnudge-unknown-{{SID}}; printf '{}' | CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR={{FIX}}/cfg-{{SID}} bash .claude/hooks/session-cleanup.sh; printf 'exit=%s kept=%s' "$?" "$(ls /tmp/claude-clearnudge-unknown-{{SID}} 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
